---
title: "Banner Explicit Color"
author: "Norah Jones"
title-block-banner: "#FFDDFF"
title-block-banner-color: "#111111"
# Title-block parity corpus (bd-gx9cic8z, P5 bd-364ol5lu): an explicit
# banner color/text-color generates an include-in-header <style> whose
# rules target .quarto-title-block .quarto-title-banner (design
# decision Q5 — doc metadata beats the theme by source order +
# specificity, no !important).
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      dom-parity: true
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            "header#title-block-header div.quarto-title-banner",
            "main.content.quarto-banner-title-block",
          ]
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - [
            # Banner header first in the body, above #quarto-content (P5);
            # pinned here rather than with a `body >` DOM selector, which the
            # live preview (mounted into div#root) cannot satisfy (bd-xiz1a2go).
            '<body[^>]*>\s*<header id="title-block-header"',
            "\\.quarto-title-block \\.quarto-title-banner \\{[^}]*background: #FFDDFF;",
            "\\.quarto-title-block \\.quarto-title-banner h1[^{]*\\{[^}]*color: #111111;",
          ]
        - []
---

Body.
